spec2def(faultrep.dll faultrep.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# faultrep.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/faultrep-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(faultrep_shims OBJECT faultrep.c)
target_link_libraries(faultrep_shims PRIVATE wine libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(faultrep_shims)
add_cargo_module(faultrep faultrep-cargo faultrep.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS faultrep_shims psdk)
